title: q2-periodontitis: a QIIME 2 plugin for Socransky complexes and the Subgingival Microbial Dysbiosis Index in 16S rRNA amplicon data
description: QIIME 2 plugin that summarises subgingival 16S rRNA amplicon profiles as Socransky microbial complexes and computes the published Subgingival Microbial Dysbiosis Index (SMDI; Chen, Marsh & Al-Hebshi 2022), its simplified three-genus form, the moderate-evidence taxa of Pérez-Chaparro et al. (2014) and quality-control measures. Validated on public subgingival 16S cohorts (docs/VALIDATION.md).
